checks.check: decimals are exact: 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.3, and 1,234.565 is kept to the last place
accounting negatives (1,000.00) and trailing minus are read as negative
currency precision: SAR 2 places, KWD 3 places, half-up
text that is not a number is never turned into zero
a text file named .xlsx is refused before reading, with the reason
CSV and .xlsb are refused with what to do
an empty file is refused
a file over 25 MB is refused
.xls (Excel 97-2003) is read like .xlsx: the same lines and amounts
.xlsm is read as data only (macros never run), with every sheet
a simple sheet: six cost lines with quantity, unit, rate and amount
each line keeps its sheet, row and cell references, and its original text
an amount from a formula keeps the formula and says so
the grand total row is recognised and becomes the control total, not a cost line
header rows are found where they are (row 4, row 3, row 1), with other column names
title rows above the header are not taken as cost lines
a hidden sheet is read and marked hidden
a two-row header under a merged heading ("Price" over Rate and Amount) maps rate and amount to their own columns
a merged section heading becomes the section of the lines below it
formula subtotals (SUM over the rows above) and the grand total are detected, never counted as cost lines
numbered sections (1, 2) carry to their lines
the sum of the cost lines equals the grand total in this file
an amount linked to a backup sheet says which sheet and cell it comes from
the summary sheet grand total is chosen as the control total when the backup has its own total
material and labour amount columns are kept as a breakdown beside the total amount
a negative adjustment is kept with its sign and flagged
a currency column gives each line its currency
a formula saved without its calculated value: the amount is missing (never zero) and flagged
a sheet without a header row asks for a header mapping, with a preview
with a header mapping given by a person, the sheet is read: two lines from row 3
every non-empty row is kept: rows that are not cost lines stay as sections, notes, subtotals or totals
the same file read twice gives the same fingerprint
"630 sq.mm XLPE cable", "XLPE cable 630mm2" and "Power cable 630 sq mm" all read 630 mm²
...but the 13.8 kV cable is not the same item as the 132 kV ones, and 300 mm² is not 630 mm²
abbreviations, units and spelling: "S&I", "cu.m", "labor"
currency notation: SR, US$, €
the original description is never replaced
"Supply of rebar" → Civil Works → Reinforcement / Rebar, cost type Material, by an approved rule
"Rebar fixing crew" → Civil manpower, cost type Manpower: the WBS destination is kept apart from the cost type
"Cable pulling technicians" → Electrical Manpower → Cable laying
"Excavation for cable trench" → Civil Works → Excavation (cost type left for the reviewer)
"Site villa rent" → accommodation (SM4), "Recruitment fees" → recruitment (SM5)
"Transformer supply" (SAR 5.7 million) is proposed as Transformers but held for review as high value
value thresholds are by currency: EUR 1.64 million is high value at the EUR limit
combined supply-and-install lines go to Split Required; no split is invented
financing, contingency and management reserve need a person whatever the score (mandatory review)
a negative adjustment is held for review
a line whose formula result is missing is held for review
unknown descriptions stay Unclassified; no WBS is invented
section headings, subtotals and totals are not classified
an inactive element is never a destination: the villa line no longer goes to SM4
until the company approves the master, nothing is classified (no destination exists)
an element past its effective-to date is not used
a parent (not postable) element is never a destination
an approved global mapping classifies a line no rule knows, at 100%, and names the mapping and its version
a project mapping wins over a project-type mapping, which wins over a global one
another project's mapping is not used
two approved mappings that disagree send the line to review, never pick one
an expired mapping is not used
an alias of an approved mapping matches too
a mapping to an element that is no longer approved is not used
two rules of the same priority with different destinations: review, with both shown
a rule not yet approved is not used
raising the automatic threshold above the rule strength sends rule results to confirmation (Proposed)
a similarity match is never auto-classified, however close
below the review threshold a match is a hint only (Unclassified)
malformed provider output is rejected; the line stays, flagged, for a person
a WBS the provider invents is rejected (it is not in the approved master)
a provider failure does not lose the line: it stays for review with the reason
a provider that tries to give an amount is rejected
a valid provider proposal at 99% still needs a person (never auto-classified on its own)
the amount of the line is never changed by classification
bulk approval takes a clean auto-classification
bulk approval never takes high-value, mandatory, conflicting or combined lines
a sheet a summary line takes its amount from is a supporting backup; the sheet of the control total is the summary
a hidden calculation sheet next to a summary is proposed as a backup
the basis of each proposal is given
only summaries and detailed breakdowns count
two descriptions of the same cable with the same quantity, rate and amount are a "same figures" candidate, to be decided
similar descriptions with a different size (630 against 300 mm2) are only shown as different specifications, not blocking
the 13.8 kV cable is not a candidate of the 132 kV cable
the summary line linked to the backup sheet is a backup candidate with its three backup lines adding up to it
a combined line equal to the total of a breakdown sheet is a backup candidate too
candidate ids are stable: the same lines give the same id
duplicate: every line not kept stops counting
a valid independent cost keeps both lines counting
duplicate with no line kept is refused
backup: the summary line counts and the backup lines do not
backup counted in detail: the backup lines count (whatever their sheet's role) and the summary line does not
the tolerance is the larger of the amount and the percentage, by currency and project type
a split by percentages gives exact amounts that add up to the line
rounding to the currency goes to the last row, never lost
amounts that do not add up to the line are shown with the difference
percentages that do not make 100 are refused
the header is found below a title row, with the SAP WBS ID, code, description, user field and cost type columns
the three amount columns are offered (Tender, Rev 0, Revised Rev 0)
five element rows, with their actual SAP WBS IDs kept as written, and the total row recognised
a sheet without a SAP WBS column is refused with the reason
a workbook with mistakes is still parsed row by row, so each refused row can be shown with its reason
